## How TikTok Shop works

TikTok Shop is TikTok's native commerce layer: brands list products directly
in-app and sell through in-feed shoppable videos, live shopping (real-time
selling during a TikTok LIVE stream), and a shop tab on the brand's profile.

The affiliate layer is the primary growth mechanism — creators attach a
brand's products to their own videos and earn commission on completed sales,
letting a brand reach audiences through creator content without producing or
paying for the media itself.

### What a brand needs to succeed
1. A product that demonstrates well on video
2. Margin that supports a competitive commission rate
3. A real sampling and creator-outreach system
4. Fulfillment that can absorb sudden order spikes

### Launching an affiliate program
1. Set up and audit the shop (listings, pricing, commission)
2. Build the affiliate resource hub (commission rates, sample availability, content guidelines)
3. Register for TAP Campaigns so creators can discover and request samples
4. Recruit and seed creators whose audience matches the product
5. Track performance and reallocate sampling/commission toward what converts

Full guide: https://cultcontent.cc/tiktok-shop

A TikTok Shop agency manages the full operational layer of selling on TikTok Shop for a brand: shop setup and optimization, recruiting and managing creator affiliates, producing content, running live shopping events, and analyzing performance data. Cult Content has managed TikTok Shop for 100+ brands through a vetted network of 700+ creators.

Cult Content's full-service management operates on a growth-partner model where compensation is tied to the GMV generated, aligning incentives with brand outcomes rather than charging a flat retainer regardless of performance. For brands that want a faster, lower-cost entry point, The Foundation package is a one-time $1,497 engagement covering an account audit, affiliate resource hub setup, outreach automation, and TAP Campaign registration.

### How long does it take to get started with Cult Content?
The Foundation package is delivered in 7 days from kickoff: account audit call, affiliate resource hub and outreach automation setup (built in parallel), then TAP Campaign registration so creators can start sampling products immediately.

### What size brands does Cult Content work with?
Cult Content works with e-commerce brands already generating meaningful revenue on TikTok Shop and looking to scale — operators who want a growth partner managing the creator and affiliate layer, not a brand starting from zero with no product-market fit.

### What's the difference between using an agency and building an in-house team?
Building in-house means hiring, training, and managing your own affiliate recruiters and content team from scratch — slow, and without existing creator relationships. An agency like Cult Content gives immediate access to an already-vetted network of 700+ creators, skipping the cold-outreach and vetting process entirely.

No. Account setup and optimization is part of Cult Content's onboarding process, whether a brand is starting fresh or already has a shop that needs restructuring.

### What happens during onboarding?
Onboarding starts with an account audit call to understand the product catalog, pricing, and current shop setup, followed by building out the affiliate resource hub and outreach systems that power ongoing creator recruitment.

### How does Cult Content's revenue-share model work?
Rather than charging a fixed monthly retainer regardless of outcomes, Cult Content's full-service engagement ties compensation to the GMV it generates for the brand — positioning the relationship as a growth partnership rather than a vendor arrangement.
